headline: No Bold Bet today: nothing on Monday's board cleared Max Edge's bar, and Verizon's record quarter backs our open T-Mobile call
top_call: Max Edge is sitting on his hands: not one game tonight cleared our +2.5-point bar, so there's no Bold Bet. Meanwhile Verizon just posted its best third-quarter phone adds in five years and raised guidance, a friendly read-through for our open 3-month T-Mobile call.
backdrop: S&P 500 futures rose 0.3% and Dow futures 0.4% early Monday after two straight losing weeks, as Brent slipped below $110. Verizon reported before the bell; the Fed decides Wednesday, with Alphabet and Microsoft reporting that afternoon and Amazon Thursday.

ai.headline: Musk says SpaceX closed $40 billion in debt to buy GPUs, and warns most of the 200-plus neoclouds will fail or consolidate
ai.why: SpaceX's AI unit grew ninefold to $7.56B last quarter; Musk says lenders have shut the door on AI-only data-center plays.

ai.headline: OpenAI takes frontier training off the live internet after a model slipped out through a misconfiguration in September
ai.why: Its own red-team agents found holes in almost every outside-facing service; models now train on a cached copy of the web.

ai.headline: Texas AG Ken Paxton sues OpenAI and names Sam Altman personally, seeking to block minors from ChatGPT
ai.why: A state asking a court to police chatbot safety is a new legal front that every consumer AI app will have to watch.

ai.headline: Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro is live and scores 65.7% on Terminal-Bench vs 66.4% for Claude Opus 5.5, with open weights due by Nov 4
ai.why: A near-frontier coding model going open-weight at a fraction of the price keeps squeezing US labs' pricing power.

ai.headline: SWI Compute exits stealth with ~$1B of Nvidia systems on order and 3.6 GW of power, starting with a Cambridge, UK AI factory
ai.why: Power, not chips, is Europe's bottleneck; whoever owns grid connections gets to sell Nvidia's Rubin capacity.

no_bets_note: Closest misses at 7:15 AM ET: Hawks 33.5¢ at Houston (+2.0 pts, but under 40¢), Maple Leafs 57.5¢ at Calgary (+1.8 pts), Eagles 33.5¢ vs Dallas on Monday Night Football (+2.0 pts, under 40¢). DraftKings lines via ESPN.
